members.note: A reader for the closed path settled experience -> candidate Definition -> no standing taken -> institution-neutral composition. P15-Q4.1 to Q4.3 are graded by conformance/commissioning.py, which imports no participant code, on an observation built by reading files under the repository root. No session or transcript is consulted. It reads the working tree and not a git object, so a second participant reproduces the reading only from a clean tree, which is why every reading of this member has been taken at a frozen commit. A clean tree was not enough on its own: a directory-addressed member was digested from every file beneath it, so importing the service wrote bytecode and the candidate's identity moved, and three clean checkouts of one commit produced three different proposal ids. A tenth reading then showed that the first repair, a hand-written list of generated names, was a third such list in this repository agreeing with neither .gitignore nor scripts/lint.py, and that six ordinary ignored forms it missed each moved the digest. The declaration is read now rather than restated: .gitignore is tracked and needs no git to open, and what is implemented is the subset of its syntax this repository uses, over a floor of generated names for a root that declares none. The same reading showed the digest was not injective, since an unframed concatenation let a member holding `ab` with empty contents collide with one holding `a` containing `b`; each name and each body is length-framed now. Framing moved the live identity from proposal:recurrence/785cd7eea6b17d50 to proposal:recurrence/1170f5d5096fddb8. Records citing the older value were true of the revisions they name and are not corrected, which is what an identity derived from bytes means. The basis is the settled member addresses of this collection: a member an independent participant observed and that landed, digested at the address it declares, with a missing address reported as a defect rather than dropped. The candidate is derived and emitted, never persisted: its identity is a digest over its basis, it carries standing RECORDED and authority_effect NONE, and synthesis is observed to leave STATUS.yaml, contracts/phases.json and this collection byte-identical. selfcheck builds the basis under a fixture root and proves nine defeating variants each fail exactly the predicates they declare, that the positive variant cites neither the member nobody witnessed nor the one an observation refused, and that the live reading reaches this repository at all. The mispaired variant says its term in every prose key the rule excludes, at the root and again below it, carries instance data declaring it under every excluded instance key, and holds it as an ordinary dict key no schema keyword reaches, so a reader that loosens the rule in any of those directions fails the self-check by name. Its instance keys are written out rather than read from the rule, because a fixture derived from the rule under test empties itself when that rule is narrowed; unit tests pin them equal to the rule's own tuples. That pin forces the two to move together and does not say which keys belong in either. For the instance keys, narrowing the rule alone fails the self-check and widening it alone fails the tests; for the prose keys, narrowing the rule alone is inert, because that tuple governs recursion rather than collection and nothing in the variant's prose values is reached by recursing into them, so only the equality test fires. Narrowing rule and fixture together passes everything either way. The pin raises the cost of that regression from one edit to two and does not refuse it, and no fixture anchored to the rule it grades can. What is measured and what is asserted are kept apart, because four readings attacked the difference. The pairing of each governed primitive to a contract is asserted: that contracts/principal.schema.json is this repository's identity primitive is a fact about naming, held by whoever names things, and no rule supplies it. It is written down in scripts/sovrecurrence/neutrality.py so a reader can challenge one line of it. What is measured is in scripts/sovrecurrence/declaration.py and is deliberately small: the contract parses and declares the paired term in its own identity ($id, or a root-level _id or _schema value carrying no whitespace) or among the names it defines under $defs, definitions, properties and patternProperties. Prose is not read anywhere - not descriptions, notes, comments, warrants, titles or names - and instance data under examples is not read either. The self-check refuses a reader that reads any of them, because the mispaired variant says its term in every one of those keys and declares it in none. Institution neutrality is measured separately: an enum closed to two or more of Controller, Orchestrator, Worker and Witness with no alternate role defeats the primitive, in the bound contract or in a contract that bound contract names as its own governed_by, wherever in the tree that contract sits. The live reading against this repository reads three settled sources, one per clause that carries a settled member, and reports P15-Q4.1 and P15-Q4.2 holding and P15-Q4.3 NOT holding for two reasons: no contract in this repository declares `discovery`, and contracts/ticket-settlement.json, the `settlement` primitive's contract, names contracts/issue-metadata.schema.json as governing it, where three role vocabularies are closed against an alternate institution. That second reason is this custody's own stated defeating condition, met. `run` exits 1 here for that reason and `selfcheck` exits 0, because the instrument discriminates while the repository does not yet satisfy the predicate. Ten readings, none supporting BUILT -> WITNESSED. Pass 1 at fe91c65, pass 2 at a3ac836, pass 3 at 9253eb5, pass 4 at e898d06, pass 5 at 1ce4d21, pass 6 at 6d02eef, pass 7 at 5632495, pass 8 at 0b8b000, pass 9 at 3ffa1b5, pass 10 at 964abd7; the records are conformance/observations/2026-09-08-definition-recurrence-p15-x4-pass1.json through pass10.json. Passes 7 through 10 were asked the landing question apart from the standing question, and none objects to landing at BUILT. Pass 7 was asked both and would refuse WITNESSED. Passes 8, 9 and 10 were asked about the repairs rather than the standing and record that they did not reopen the refusal, which is not the same as making one. That every reading came from one model family in one container is why the count is not the evidence; what each one found and reproduced is. How independent they are is a question the repository cannot settle, and this note does not pretend otherwise. What is checkable: every commit trailer on this branch reads Claude Opus 5 and all ten pass records carry claude-opus-5 participant ids, so no reading came from outside the builder's model family; and pass 4's own record declares built_the_repair true. It refused e898d06 as a witness and then built f43ee9a, which makes its reading of that repair a build claim rather than an observation. What rests on a participant's own word: pass 4's report that it ran in a separate container from a fresh clone under a prompt from the root seat. Passes 4 through 10 each record a container and a prompt in their own independence block; passes 1 through 3 record neither. Nothing outside a reading corroborates either, and a later record quoting an earlier one is not corroboration. An earlier draft of this note asserted the container as fact while withdrawing the model claim for want of evidence, which applied two standards to one self-report; both are now stated as what they are. Six claims this participant made and could not support are withdrawn by name in the pass-4 corrections block rather than edited away, among them that scripts/verify.py does not run these unit tests, which it does. Residuals this member does not close, carried rather than hidden. The standing and work_state of a member are believed as written; nothing here corroborates them, so a member falsely recorded as settled would be admitted. In the live path P15-Q4.1 grades whether synthesis preserved the basis it was handed, not whether the gathering was right; only the fixture proves that predicate can fail. scripts/verify.py reaches this member twice, through the definition recurrence slice and through the tooling tests, and neither asserts the live verdict; what the slice now also proves is that the live reading reaches this repository, which it did not before. A const, a pattern, and a required-property closure are not read. One closed vocabulary is reported and not graded, in contracts/product-canon.schema.json; the `settlement` primitive names the instance contracts/product-canon.json in its governed_by and not that schema, and the link between them is a filename convention rather than a declaration, so following it would be a judgement this reader does not make. BUILT only. A test may not claim WITNESSED, and this reader cannot cite itself until an independent participant observes it and it lands.
